Q1.en: Write both ratios in terms of sine and cosine: \(\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A}\). So the product is \(\frac{(1 - \cos A)(1 + \cos A)}{\sin A} = \frac{1 - \cos^2 A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2 A}{\sin A} = \sin A\), which is the choice \(\sin A\).
Q1.hi: दोनों अनुपातों को sine और cosine में लिखने पर \(\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A = \frac{1 - \cos A}{\sin A}\)। अतः गुणनफल \(\frac{(1 - \cos A)(1 + \cos A)}{\sin A} = \frac{1 - \cos^2 A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2 A}{\sin A} = \sin A\) है, जो विकल्प \(\sin A\) है।

Q2.en: The die has six faces, and three of them (1, 3, 5) are odd. So the probability is \(\frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{2}\).
Q2.hi: पासे के छह फलक होते हैं, जिनमें से तीन (1, 3, 5) विषम हैं। अतः प्रायिकता \(\frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{2}\) है।

Q3.en: Here \(N = 3 + 2 + 5 + 4 + 1 = 15\), so \(\frac{N}{2} = 7.5\). The cumulative frequencies are 3, 5, 10, 14, 15, and the first one greater than 7.5 is 10, which belongs to the class 10-15. So the median class is the choice 10-15.

Q4.en: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. The highest frequency is 12, for the class 7-14, so the modal class is the choice 7-14.
Q4.hi: बहुलक वर्ग वह वर्ग है जिसकी बारंबारता सबसे अधिक हो। सबसे अधिक बारंबारता 12 है, जो वर्ग 7-14 की है। अतः बहुलक वर्ग 7-14 है, जो विकल्प 7-14 है।

Q5.en: The die has 6 faces, and the letter \(\boxed{A}\) is on 2 of them. So the probability of getting \(\boxed{A}\) is \(\frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{3}\).
Q5.hi: पासे के 6 फलक हैं, जिनमें से 2 फलकों पर अक्षर \(\boxed{A}\) अंकित है। अतः \(\boxed{A}\) प्राप्त होने की प्रायिकता \(\frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{3}\) है।

Q6.en: Since \(\cot \theta = \frac{8}{15}\), take the base 8k and the perpendicular 15k. Then the hypotenuse is \(\sqrt{(8k)^2 + (15k)^2} = \sqrt{289k^2} = 17k\). So \(\sin \theta = \frac{15k}{17k} = \frac{15}{17}\), which is the choice \(\frac{15}{17}\).
Q6.hi: चूँकि \(\cot \theta = \frac{8}{15}\), माना आधार 8k तथा लंब 15k है। तब कर्ण \(\sqrt{(8k)^2 + (15k)^2} = \sqrt{289k^2} = 17k\) है। अतः \(\sin \theta = \frac{15k}{17k} = \frac{15}{17}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{15}{17}\) है।

Q7.en: Since \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), we get \(\operatorname{cosec} 60^\circ = \frac{1}{\sin 60^\circ} = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\), which is the choice \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\).

Q8.en: Using \(\operatorname{cosec} \theta = \frac{1}{\sin \theta}\) and \(\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta}\): \(\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 \theta}{\sec^2 \theta} = \frac{\cos^2 \theta}{\sin^2 \theta} = \cot^2 \theta\), which is the choice \(\cot^2 \theta\).
Q8.hi: \(\operatorname{cosec} \theta = \frac{1}{\sin \theta}\) तथा \(\sec \theta = \frac{1}{\cos \theta}\) का प्रयोग करने पर \(\frac{\operatorname{cosec}^2 \theta}{\sec^2 \theta} = \frac{\cos^2 \theta}{\sin^2 \theta} = \cot^2 \theta\), जो विकल्प \(\cot^2 \theta\) है।

Q9.en: For two numbers, HCF \(\times\) LCM = product of the numbers. So LCM \(= \frac{35 \times 49}{7} = 5 \times 49 = 245\), which is the choice 245.
Q9.hi: दो संख्याओं के लिए HCF \(\times\) LCM = संख्याओं का गुणनफल। अतः LCM \(= \frac{35 \times 49}{7} = 5 \times 49 = 245\), जो विकल्प 245 है।

Q10.en: By prime factorisation, \(306 = 2 \times 3^2 \times 17\) and \(657 = 3^2 \times 73\). The only common factor is \(3^2\), so the HCF is 9, which is the choice 9.
Q10.hi: अभाज्य गुणनखंडन से \(306 = 2 \times 3^2 \times 17\) तथा \(657 = 3^2 \times 73\)। उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड केवल \(3^2\) है, अतः HCF = 9, जो विकल्प 9 है।

Q11.en: Product of the two numbers = HCF \(\times\) LCM \(= 6 \times 168 = 1008\). So the second number is \(\frac{1008}{24} = 42\), which is the choice 42.
Q11.hi: दोनों संख्याओं का गुणनफल = HCF \(\times\) LCM \(= 6 \times 168 = 1008\)। अतः दूसरी संख्या \(\frac{1008}{24} = 42\) है, जो विकल्प 42 है।

Q12.en: By the distance formula, the distance is \(\sqrt{(2a - a)^2 + (2b - b)^2} = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\), which is the choice \(\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}\).

Q13.en: The tangent at \(P\) is perpendicular to the radius \(OP\), so \(\Delta OPQ\) is right-angled at \(P\). Then \(OQ = \sqrt{OP^2 + PQ^2} = \sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{169} = 13\) cm, which is the choice 13 cm.
Q13.hi: बिन्दु \(P\) पर स्पर्श-रेखा त्रिज्या \(OP\) पर लंब होती है, अतः \(\Delta OPQ\) में \(P\) पर समकोण है। तब \(OQ = \sqrt{OP^2 + PQ^2} = \sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{169} = 13\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 13 सेमी है।

Q14.en: By the SAS similarity criterion, one pair of equal angles is enough if the sides that include those angles are proportional. The angle \(\angle B\) is included between \(AB\) and \(BC\), and \(\angle E\) between \(DE\) and \(EF\). So the triangles are similar if \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{BC}{EF}\), which is the choice \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{BC}{EF}\).
Q14.hi: SAS समरूपता कसौटी के अनुसार, यदि एक कोण बराबर हो और उस कोण को अंतर्गत करने वाली भुजाएँ समानुपाती हों, तो त्रिभुज समरूप होते हैं। \(\angle B\) भुजाओं \(AB\) और \(BC\) के बीच है तथा \(\angle E\) भुजाओं \(DE\) और \(EF\) के बीच है। अतः त्रिभुज समरूप होंगे यदि \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{BC}{EF}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{AB}{DE} = \frac{BC}{EF}\) है।

Q15.en: Area of a sector \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{90}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{1}{4} \times 154 = 38.5\) \(\text{cm}^2\), which is the choice 38.5 \(\text{cm}^2\).
Q15.hi: त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{90}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{1}{4} \times 154 = 38.5\) सेमी\(^2\), जो विकल्प 38.5 सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q16.en: The surface of the toy is the curved surface of the cone plus the curved surface of the hemisphere. Curved surface of the cone \(= \pi r l = \pi \times 4 \times 12 = 48\pi\) \(\text{cm}^2\); curved surface of the hemisphere \(= 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi \times 16 = 32\pi\) \(\text{cm}^2\). Total \(= 48\pi + 32\pi = 80\pi\) \(\text{cm}^2\), which is the choice \(80\pi\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
Q16.hi: खिलौने का पृष्ठ = शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठ + अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठ। शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(= \pi r l = \pi \times 4 \times 12 = 48\pi\) सेमी\(^2\); अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(= 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi \times 16 = 32\pi\) सेमी\(^2\)। संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(= 48\pi + 32\pi = 80\pi\) सेमी\(^2\), जो विकल्प \(80\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q17.en: Splitting the middle term: \(x^2 + 7x + 12 = x^2 + 3x + 4x + 12 = (x + 3)(x + 4)\). So the zeroes are \(-3\) and \(-4\), which is the choice \(-4, -3\).

Q18.en: Adding the two equations gives \(2x = 16\), so \(x = 8\). Then \(y = 14 - 8 = 6\). The solution is \(x = 8, y = 6\), which is the choice \(x = 8, y = 6\).

Q19.en: For equal roots the discriminant must be zero: \(b^2 - 4ac = (2\sqrt{6})^2 - 4 \times K \times 3 = 24 - 12K = 0\), so \(K = 2\), which is the choice 2.
Q19.hi: मूल समान होने के लिए विविक्तकर शून्य होना चाहिए: \(b^2 - 4ac = (2\sqrt{6})^2 - 4 \times K \times 3 = 24 - 12K = 0\), अतः \(K = 2\), जो विकल्प 2 है।

Q20.en: Here \(a = -6\) and \(d = -4 - (-6) = 2\). So \(a_7 = a + 6d = -6 + 6 \times 2 = 6\), which is the choice 6.

B1a.en:
Suppose, to the contrary, that \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) is rational. Then \(6 - \sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), where \(p\) and \(q\) are integers and \(q \neq 0\).
So \(\sqrt{2} = 6 - \frac{p}{q} = \frac{6q - p}{q}\).
Since \(p\) and \(q\) are integers, \(\frac{6q - p}{q}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{2}\) would be rational.
But \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from the wrong assumption that \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) is rational.
Hence \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) is irrational.
B1a.hi:
इसके विपरीत, माना कि \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) परिमेय है। तब \(6 - \sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), जहाँ \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(q \neq 0\)।
अतः \(\sqrt{2} = 6 - \frac{p}{q} = \frac{6q - p}{q}\)।
चूँकि \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं, इसलिए \(\frac{6q - p}{q}\) परिमेय है, अर्थात् \(\sqrt{2}\) परिमेय होगा।
परन्तु \(\sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है। यह विरोधाभास इस गलत कल्पना के कारण है कि \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) परिमेय है।
अतः \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है।

B1b.en:
Any point on the \(x\)-axis has the form \(P(x, 0)\). Since it is equidistant from \((2, -5)\) and \((-2, 9)\), the squares of the distances are equal:
\((x - 2)^2 + (0 + 5)^2 = (x + 2)^2 + (0 - 9)^2\)
\(x^2 - 4x + 4 + 25 = x^2 + 4x + 4 + 81\)
\(-4x + 29 = 4x + 85\)
\(-8x = 56\), so \(x = -7\).
Hence the required point is \((-7, 0)\).

B1c.en:
Let \(P\), \(Q\), \(R\) be the points that divide \(AB\) into four equal parts, in that order from \(A\). Then \(P\) divides \(AB\) in the ratio \(1 : 3\), \(Q\) in \(1 : 1\) and \(R\) in \(3 : 1\).
By the section formula:
\(P = \left(\frac{1 \times 2 + 3 \times (-2)}{4}, \frac{1 \times 8 + 3 \times 2}{4}\right) = \left(-1, \frac{7}{2}\right)\)
\(Q\) is the mid-point: \(Q = \left(\frac{-2 + 2}{2}, \frac{2 + 8}{2}\right) = (0, 5)\)
\(R = \left(\frac{3 \times 2 + 1 \times (-2)}{4}, \frac{3 \times 8 + 1 \times 2}{4}\right) = \left(1, \frac{13}{2}\right)\)
Hence the required points are \(\left(-1, \frac{7}{2}\right)\), \((0, 5)\) and \(\left(1, \frac{13}{2}\right)\).
B1c.hi:
माना \(P\), \(Q\), \(R\) वे बिन्दु हैं जो \(AB\) को चार बराबर भागों में बाँटते हैं (\(A\) की ओर से इसी क्रम में)। तब \(P\) रेखाखंड \(AB\) को \(1 : 3\) में, \(Q\) को \(1 : 1\) में तथा \(R\) को \(3 : 1\) के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है।
विभाजन सूत्र से:
\(P = \left(\frac{1 \times 2 + 3 \times (-2)}{4}, \frac{1 \times 8 + 3 \times 2}{4}\right) = \left(-1, \frac{7}{2}\right)\)
\(Q\) मध्य-बिन्दु है: \(Q = \left(\frac{-2 + 2}{2}, \frac{2 + 8}{2}\right) = (0, 5)\)
\(R = \left(\frac{3 \times 2 + 1 \times (-2)}{4}, \frac{3 \times 8 + 1 \times 2}{4}\right) = \left(1, \frac{13}{2}\right)\)
अतः अभीष्ट बिन्दु \(\left(-1, \frac{7}{2}\right)\), \((0, 5)\) और \(\left(1, \frac{13}{2}\right)\) हैं।

B1d.en:
Multiply the numerator and the denominator inside the root by \(1 + \sin \theta\):
\(\text{LHS} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin \theta)(1 + \sin \theta)}{(1 - \sin \theta)(1 + \sin \theta)}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{1 - \sin^2 \theta}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{\cos^2 \theta}}\)
Taking the positive square root,
\(\text{LHS} = \frac{1 + \sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \frac{1}{\cos \theta} + \frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \sec \theta + \tan \theta = \text{RHS}\).
Hence proved.
B1d.hi:
मूल के अंदर अंश और हर को \(1 + \sin \theta\) से गुणा करने पर:
\(\text{L.H.S.} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin \theta)(1 + \sin \theta)}{(1 - \sin \theta)(1 + \sin \theta)}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{1 - \sin^2 \theta}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin \theta)^2}{\cos^2 \theta}}\)
धनात्मक वर्गमूल लेने पर,
\(\text{L.H.S.} = \frac{1 + \sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \frac{1}{\cos \theta} + \frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta} = \sec \theta + \tan \theta = \text{R.H.S.}\)
इति सिद्धम्।

B1e.en:
Here \(r = 21\) cm and \(\theta = 60^\circ\).
Area of the sector \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 \times 21 = 231\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
The two radii and the chord form a triangle with two sides equal (21 cm each) and the included angle \(60^\circ\), so it is equilateral with side 21 cm.
Area of the triangle \(= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 21^2 = \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
Area of the segment = area of the sector \(-\) area of the triangle \(= \left(231 - \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
Taking \(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\): \(\frac{441 \times 1.732}{4} = 190.953\), so the area of the segment \(\approx 231 - 190.953 = 40.05\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
B1e.hi:
यहाँ \(r = 21\) सेमी तथा \(\theta = 60^\circ\)।
त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 \times 21 = 231\) सेमी\(^2\)।
दोनों त्रिज्याएँ और जीवा एक त्रिभुज बनाती हैं जिसकी दो भुजाएँ बराबर (प्रत्येक 21 सेमी) हैं और उनके बीच का कोण \(60^\circ\) है, अतः यह 21 सेमी भुजा वाला समबाहु त्रिभुज है।
त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 21^2 = \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\) सेमी\(^2\)।
संगत वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल = त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल \(= \left(231 - \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)\) सेमी\(^2\)।
\(\sqrt{3} = 1.732\) लेने पर \(\frac{441 \times 1.732}{4} = 190.953\), अतः वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(\approx 231 - 190.953 = 40.05\) सेमी\(^2\)।

B1f.en:
Total number of marbles \(= 4 + 8 + 5 = 17\), and each is equally likely to be taken out.
(i) There are 4 red marbles, so \(P(\text{red}) = \frac{4}{17}\).
(ii) Marbles that are not green \(= 4 + 8 = 12\), so \(P(\text{not green}) = \frac{12}{17}\). (Equivalently, \(1 - \frac{5}{17} = \frac{12}{17}\).)

B2a.en:
Let \(O\) be the common centre, and let \(PQ\) be the chord of the larger circle that touches the smaller circle at \(M\).
Since \(PQ\) is a tangent to the smaller circle at \(M\), the radius \(OM\) is perpendicular to \(PQ\). So \(OM = 4.5\) cm and \(\angle OMP = 90^\circ\).
Also \(OP = 7.5\) cm (radius of the larger circle).
In right \(\Delta OMP\), by Pythagoras theorem:
\(PM = \sqrt{OP^2 - OM^2} = \sqrt{7.5^2 - 4.5^2} = \sqrt{56.25 - 20.25} = \sqrt{36} = 6\) cm.
The perpendicular from the centre to a chord bisects the chord, so \(PQ = 2 \times PM = 2 \times 6 = 12\) cm.
Hence the length of the chord is 12 cm.
B2a.hi:
माना \(O\) उभयनिष्ठ केन्द्र है और \(PQ\) बड़े वृत्त की वह जीवा है जो छोटे वृत्त को बिन्दु \(M\) पर स्पर्श करती है।
चूँकि \(PQ\) छोटे वृत्त की बिन्दु \(M\) पर स्पर्श-रेखा है, अतः त्रिज्या \(OM\), \(PQ\) पर लंब है। अतः \(OM = 4.5\) सेमी तथा \(\angle OMP = 90^\circ\)।
साथ ही \(OP = 7.5\) सेमी (बड़े वृत्त की त्रिज्या)।
समकोण \(\Delta OMP\) में पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से:
\(PM = \sqrt{OP^2 - OM^2} = \sqrt{7.5^2 - 4.5^2} = \sqrt{56.25 - 20.25} = \sqrt{36} = 6\) सेमी।
केन्द्र से जीवा पर डाला गया लंब जीवा को समद्विभाजित करता है, अतः \(PQ = 2 \times PM = 2 \times 6 = 12\) सेमी।
अतः जीवा की लंबाई 12 सेमी है।

B2b.en:
In \(\Delta PQR\), \(\angle PQR = \angle 1\) and \(\angle PRQ = \angle 2\). Given \(\angle 1 = \angle 2\), the sides opposite these equal angles are equal, so \(PR = PQ\). ...(i)
Given \(\frac{QR}{QS} = \frac{QT}{PR}\). Using (i), \(\frac{QR}{QS} = \frac{QT}{PQ}\), that is \(\frac{PQ}{QT} = \frac{QS}{QR}\). ...(ii)
Now in \(\Delta PQS\) and \(\Delta TQR\):
\(\frac{PQ}{TQ} = \frac{QS}{QR}\) (from (ii))
\(\angle PQS = \angle TQR\) (each is \(\angle 1\), common angle)
So by the SAS similarity criterion, \(\Delta PQS \sim \Delta TQR\).
Hence proved.
B2b.hi:
\(\Delta PQR\) में \(\angle PQR = \angle 1\) तथा \(\angle PRQ = \angle 2\)। दिया है \(\angle 1 = \angle 2\), अतः बराबर कोणों की सम्मुख भुजाएँ बराबर होंगी, अर्थात् \(PR = PQ\)। ...(i)
दिया है \(\frac{QR}{QS} = \frac{QT}{PR}\)। (i) से \(\frac{QR}{QS} = \frac{QT}{PQ}\), अर्थात् \(\frac{PQ}{QT} = \frac{QS}{QR}\)। ...(ii)
अब \(\Delta PQS\) और \(\Delta TQR\) में:
\(\frac{PQ}{TQ} = \frac{QS}{QR}\) ((ii) से)
\(\angle PQS = \angle TQR\) (दोनों \(\angle 1\) हैं, उभयनिष्ठ कोण)
अतः SAS समरूपता कसौटी से \(\Delta PQS \sim \Delta TQR\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

B2c.en:
Here \(a = 21\) and \(d = 18 - 21 = -3\). Let \(n\) terms be needed, so \(S_n = -81\).
\(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d]\)
\(-81 = \frac{n}{2}[42 + (n - 1)(-3)] = \frac{n}{2}(45 - 3n)\)
\(-162 = 45n - 3n^2\)
\(3n^2 - 45n - 162 = 0\), that is \(n^2 - 15n - 54 = 0\)
\((n - 18)(n + 3) = 0\), so \(n = 18\) or \(n = -3\).
The number of terms cannot be negative, so \(n = 18\).
Hence 18 terms must be taken.

B2d.en:
Factorise by splitting the middle term:
\(x^2 + 10x + 21 = x^2 + 3x + 7x + 21 = x(x + 3) + 7(x + 3) = (x + 3)(x + 7)\).
The polynomial is zero when \(x = -3\) or \(x = -7\), so the zeroes are \(\alpha = -3\) and \(\beta = -7\).
Verification (here \(a = 1\), \(b = 10\), \(c = 21\)):
Sum of zeroes \(= -3 + (-7) = -10\), and \(-\frac{b}{a} = -\frac{10}{1} = -10\).
Product of zeroes \(= (-3)(-7) = 21\), and \(\frac{c}{a} = \frac{21}{1} = 21\).
Hence sum of zeroes \(= -\frac{b}{a}\) and product of zeroes \(= \frac{c}{a}\); the relationship is verified.

B2f.en:
First make the cumulative frequency table.

| Class interval | Frequency \(f\) | Cumulative frequency \(cf\) |
|---|---|---|
| 65-85 | 4 | 4 |
| 85-105 | 5 | 9 |
| 105-125 | 13 | 22 |
| 125-145 | 20 | 42 |
| 145-165 | 14 | 56 |
| 165-185 | 8 | 64 |
| 185-205 | 4 | 68 |

**Mode:** the highest frequency is 20, so the modal class is 125-145. Here \(l = 125\), \(f_1 = 20\), \(f_0 = 13\), \(f_2 = 14\), \(h = 20\).
Mode \(= l + \frac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2} \times h = 125 + \frac{20 - 13}{40 - 13 - 14} \times 20 = 125 + \frac{7}{13} \times 20 = 125 + 10.77 = 135.77\) (approx.)
**Median:** \(n = 68\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 34\). The cumulative frequency just greater than 34 is 42, so the median class is 125-145. Here \(l = 125\), \(cf = 22\), \(f = 20\), \(h = 20\).
Median \(= l + \frac{\frac{n}{2} - cf}{f} \times h = 125 + \frac{34 - 22}{20} \times 20 = 125 + 12 = 137\).
Hence mode \(\approx 135.77\) and median \(= 137\).

B3a.en:
Let the tens digit be \(x\) and the units digit be \(y\). Then the number is \(10x + y\), and the number with the digits reversed is \(10y + x\).
Given: \((10x + y) + (10y + x) = 99\), so \(11x + 11y = 99\), that is \(x + y = 9\). ...(i)
The digits differ by 5, so either \(x - y = 5\) ...(ii) or \(y - x = 5\) ...(iii)
Case 1: adding (i) and (ii), \(2x = 14\), so \(x = 7\) and \(y = 2\). The number is 72.
Case 2: adding (i) and (iii), \(2y = 14\), so \(y = 7\) and \(x = 2\). The number is 27.
Check: \(72 + 27 = 99\) and \(7 - 2 = 5\).
Hence the number is 72 or 27, and there are two such numbers.

B3b.en:
Let the number of articles produced that day be \(x\). Then the cost of each article is ₹ \((2x + 15)\).
Total cost = number of articles \(\times\) cost of each article:
\(x(2x + 15) = 2250\)
\(2x^2 + 15x - 2250 = 0\)
Splitting the middle term (\(2 \times 2250 = 4500 = 75 \times 60\), \(75 - 60 = 15\)):
\(2x^2 + 75x - 60x - 2250 = 0\)
\(x(2x + 75) - 30(2x + 75) = 0\)
\((x - 30)(2x + 75) = 0\), so \(x = 30\) or \(x = -\frac{75}{2}\).
The number of articles cannot be negative, so \(x = 30\).
Cost of each article \(= 2 \times 30 + 15 = ₹ 75\).
Check: \(30 \times 75 = 2250\).
Hence 30 articles were produced and each cost ₹ 75.

B4a.en:
Let \(P\) be the point on the bridge and \(M\) the point vertically below it on the line joining the banks, so \(PM = 5\) m. Let \(X\) and \(Y\) be the banks on the two sides, with angles of depression \(30^\circ\) and \(45^\circ\). Since the line of sight from \(P\) and the horizontal through \(P\) make alternate angles with \(XY\), \(\angle PXM = 30^\circ\) and \(\angle PYM = 45^\circ\).
In right \(\Delta PMX\):
\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PM}{XM}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5}{XM}\), giving \(XM = 5\sqrt{3}\) m.
In right \(\Delta PMY\):
\(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PM}{MY}\), so \(1 = \frac{5}{MY}\), giving \(MY = 5\) m.
Width of the river \(XY = XM + MY = 5\sqrt{3} + 5 = 5(\sqrt{3} + 1) = 5(1.732 + 1) = 5 \times 2.732 = 13.66\) m.
Hence the width of the river is 13.66 m.
B4a.hi:
माना पुल पर बिन्दु \(P\) है और किनारों को जोड़ने वाली रेखा पर उसके ठीक नीचे बिन्दु \(M\) है, अतः \(PM = 5\) मी.। माना \(X\) और \(Y\) नदी के सम्मुख किनारे हैं, जिनके अवनमन कोण क्रमशः \(30^\circ\) और \(45^\circ\) हैं। \(P\) से जाने वाली क्षैतिज रेखा \(XY\) के समांतर है, अतः एकान्तर कोणों से \(\angle PXM = 30^\circ\) तथा \(\angle PYM = 45^\circ\)।
समकोण \(\Delta PMX\) में:
\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PM}{XM}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{5}{XM}\), जिससे \(XM = 5\sqrt{3}\) मी.।
समकोण \(\Delta PMY\) में:
\(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PM}{MY}\), अतः \(1 = \frac{5}{MY}\), जिससे \(MY = 5\) मी.।
नदी की चौड़ाई \(XY = XM + MY = 5\sqrt{3} + 5 = 5(\sqrt{3} + 1) = 5(1.732 + 1) = 5 \times 2.732 = 13.66\) मी.।
अतः नदी की चौड़ाई 13.66 मी. है।

B4b.en:
Divide the numerator and the denominator of the left-hand side by \(\sin A\):
\(\text{LHS} = \frac{\cot A - 1 + \operatorname{cosec} A}{\cot A + 1 - \operatorname{cosec} A} = \frac{(\cot A + \operatorname{cosec} A) - 1}{\cot A - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1}\)
In the numerator, replace 1 by \(\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \cot^2 A\) (since \(1 + \cot^2 A = \operatorname{cosec}^2 A\)):
Numerator \(= (\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A) - (\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A)(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)\)
\(= (\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)(1 - \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)\)
So \(\text{LHS} = \frac{(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)(\cot A - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1)}{\cot A - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1} = \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A = \text{RHS}\).
Hence proved.
B4b.hi:
बाएँ पक्ष के अंश और हर दोनों को \(\sin A\) से भाग देने पर:
\(\text{L.H.S.} = \frac{\cot A - 1 + \operatorname{cosec} A}{\cot A + 1 - \operatorname{cosec} A} = \frac{(\cot A + \operatorname{cosec} A) - 1}{\cot A - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1}\)
अंश में 1 के स्थान पर \(\operatorname{cosec}^2 A - \cot^2 A\) रखने पर (क्योंकि \(1 + \cot^2 A = \operatorname{cosec}^2 A\)):
अंश \(= (\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A) - (\operatorname{cosec} A - \cot A)(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)\)
\(= (\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)(1 - \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)\)
अतः \(\text{L.H.S.} = \frac{(\operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A)(\cot A - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1)}{\cot A - \operatorname{cosec} A + 1} = \operatorname{cosec} A + \cot A = \text{R.H.S.}\)
इति सिद्धम्।

B5a.en:
The hemisphere rests on a face of the cube, so its diameter cannot be more than the side of the cube. Hence the greatest diameter of the hemisphere is 7 cm, and its radius is \(r = \frac{7}{2} = 3.5\) cm.
Surface area of the solid = total surface area of the cube \(-\) area of the base of the hemisphere \(+\) curved surface area of the hemisphere
\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 7^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5\)
\(= 294 + 38.5 = 332.5\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
Hence the greatest diameter is 7 cm and the surface area of the solid is 332.5 \(\text{cm}^2\).
B5a.hi:
अर्धगोला घन के एक फलक पर रखा है, अतः उसका व्यास घन की भुजा से अधिक नहीं हो सकता। अतः अर्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास 7 सेमी है, और उसकी त्रिज्या \(r = \frac{7}{2} = 3.5\) सेमी है।
ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = घन का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(-\) अर्धगोले के आधार का क्षेत्रफल \(+\) अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल
\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 7^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 3.5 \times 3.5\)
\(= 294 + 38.5 = 332.5\) सेमी\(^2\)।
अतः अर्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास 7 सेमी है और ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 332.5 सेमी\(^2\) है।

B5b.en:
Here \(r = 3\) cm and the slant height of the cone \(l = 3\sqrt{2}\) cm.
Height of the cone: \(h = \sqrt{l^2 - r^2} = \sqrt{18 - 9} = \sqrt{9} = 3\) cm.
Volume of the solid = volume of the cone \(+\) volume of the hemisphere
\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h + \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3\)
\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi \times 9 \times 3 + \frac{2}{3}\pi \times 27\)
\(= 9\pi + 18\pi = 27\pi\)
\(= 27 \times 3.14 = 84.78\) \(\text{cm}^3\).
Hence the volume of the solid is 84.78 \(\text{cm}^3\).
B5b.hi:
यहाँ \(r = 3\) सेमी तथा शंकु की तिर्यक ऊँचाई \(l = 3\sqrt{2}\) सेमी।
शंकु की ऊँचाई: \(h = \sqrt{l^2 - r^2} = \sqrt{18 - 9} = \sqrt{9} = 3\) सेमी।
ठोस का आयतन = शंकु का आयतन \(+\) अर्धगोले का आयतन
\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h + \frac{2}{3}\pi r^3\)
\(= \frac{1}{3}\pi \times 9 \times 3 + \frac{2}{3}\pi \times 27\)
\(= 9\pi + 18\pi = 27\pi\)
\(= 27 \times 3.14 = 84.78\) सेमी\(^3\)।
अतः ठोस का आयतन 84.78 सेमी\(^3\) है।
